title: Preserve overlap evidence when cache publication fails
body:
A serialization or write failure can leave a partial temporary cache file. A failed cache replacement can also return newly fetched data while warning that the old source was retained. Clean up staging across the whole write operation, and publish a source into the in-memory snapshot only after its atomic file write succeeds.

Validation: all 100 overlap-consumer tests pass on Python 3.12; the 5 new tests pass under `-O`. Injected partial serialization, disk-full and replace failures preserve the destination and close/remove staging files. A failed refresh retains the same old evidence in memory and on disk; an initial failure reports no usable snapshot. `git diff --check` passes.

Fresh main/priorities and live PR/Discussion overlap checked. This is a separate persistence scope from PR5723 cache parsing; it starts from main and does not depend on that PR. No interprocess cache-locking claim is made. Hosted CI is pending.
